title: SYNES university lecturers’ warning stoppage (possible February continuation/new call)
notes: The January unit records the SYNES work stoppage beginning 25 January with a scheduled 30 January end and no verified public gathering. February discovery leads include a 1 February Actu Cameroun headline announcing a new indefinite state-university strike (exact article yielded HTTP 403; no body) and a Douala Today article whose search result says some lecturers attended on 8 February despite a renewed call; its article body was blocked by an anti-bot challenge. No post-30 January public gathering, actual February strike attendance or qualifying threshold is established. This is a continuation lead only; do not add as a February event without new evidence.
